contexts.text: To give fodder to his donkey in the inn () = when they reflected upon the scientifics in the exterior Natural... An inn = the exterior Natural. That an inn has this signification cannot be confirmed from parallel passages... but it can from the fact that scientifics are as it were in their inn when they are in the exterior Natural... Hence this Natural is the inn, or place of rest or of passing the night, for scientifics.
When we came to the inn, and opened our sacks () = introspection into the exterior Natural. An inn = the exterior Natural in general.
It was in the way in the inn () = the posterity of Jacob, that they were in externals without an internal.
The inn = the external Natural or Sensuous.
They are colleges which are called by us inns, where disputations are carried on... TCR 460.
The fourth said... I was carried into an inn, where health returned to me.
So that (the higher region of the palate) is as it were an inn; and therefore they called their chamber... their inn.
That he brought him into an inn, and said that they were to take care of him () = that he brought him to those who are instructed in the doctrine of the Church from the Word... AE 444:end.

It is said that this was done because there was no place in the inn (); for by an inn is signified a place of instruction. This is signified by an inn in ; ; and it was with the Jews, who were then in mere falsities by the adulteration of the Word. This, therefore, is what is signified by there being no place in the inn.
From their corner, which is as it were their inn there, the Moravians go out by turns...
